description: This Java class 'EnforcedThingFlattener' flattens a 'Thing' object with an enforcer into a list of pointer-value pairs for indexing, handling JSON conversion, permission effects, and length restrictions.

classes.name: EnforcedThingFlattener
classes.description: A class that flattens a 'Thing' object with an enforcer into indexable documents, handling JSON traversal, permission effects, and length restrictions.

methods.name: flattenJson
methods.description: Static method that converts a JsonObject representing a 'Thing' into a BsonArray of index documents using an enforcer.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Handles JSON null values during traversal, producing a document with a null literal.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Handles boolean JSON values during traversal, producing a document with the boolean value.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Handles string JSON values during traversal, producing a document with the string value.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Handles numeric JSON values during traversal, producing a document with the numeric value.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Processes JSON arrays, flattening each element and limiting size based on maxArraySize.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Processes JSON objects, flattening nested structures.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Creates a document for a single JSON value, applying length restrictions, computing permission effects, and possibly replacing feature IDs with wildcards.

methods.name: computeEffectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Computes subjects affected by permissions for a given JSON pointer key.

methods.name: toBsonArray
methods.description: Converts an iterable of AuthorizationSubject to a BsonArray of their IDs.

methods.name: assembleDocument
methods.description: Assembles a BSON document with key, value, grants, and revokes.

methods.name: replaceFeatureIdByWildcard
methods.description: Replaces specific feature IDs in a JSON pointer with a wildcard, if applicable.
